Deprecated subset method for commaData objects

Source: R/accessors.R
subset.commaData.Rd

subset(commaData) is deprecated to avoid package-level masking of base::subset(). Use filterSites for common commaData filters or [ for index-based subsetting.

Usage

subset.commaData(
  x,
  mod_type = NULL,
  condition = NULL,
  chrom = NULL,
  motif = NULL,
  mod_context = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A commaData object.

mod_type

Character vector or NULL. If provided, only sites with a matching modification type are kept (e.g., "6mA").

condition

Character vector or NULL. If provided, only samples matching the specified condition(s) are kept.

chrom

Character vector or NULL. If provided, only sites on the specified chromosome(s) are kept.

motif

Character vector or NULL. If provided, only sites with a matching sequence context motif are kept (e.g., "GATC"). Sites with NA motif values are excluded when this filter is active. Use motifs to see which motifs are present.

mod_context

Character vector or NULL. If provided, only sites with a matching modification context are kept (e.g., "6mA_GATC", "5mC_CCWGG"). A mod_context value is paste(mod_type, motif, sep = "_") when motif is available, or just mod_type for Dorado/Megalodon data. Use modContexts to see which contexts are present. When provided, this filter is applied in addition to (ANDed with) any mod_type or motif filters.

...

Ignored.

Value

A commaData object containing only the selected sites and samples.
